definitions.gloss: way of teaching; teaching method; teaching style
definitions.explanation: The manner in which something is taught — covering approach, sequence, and pedagogical style. Formed from {教|おし}える + {方|かた} (way of doing).

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}の{教|おし}え{方|かた}が{上手|じょうず}だ。
examples.english: The teacher's way of teaching is skillful.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもへの{教|おし}え{方|かた}は{大人|おとな}とは{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: The way of teaching children differs from teaching adults.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}には{初心者|しょしんしゃ}にも{分|わ}かりやすい{教|おし}え{方|かた}が{紹介|しょうかい}されている。
examples.english: This book introduces a teaching method that is easy even for beginners to understand.

notes:
Verb stem + {方|かた} forms a noun meaning 'way of doing X'. Productive with most verbs ({書|か}き{方|かた}, {読|よ}み{方|かた}, {使|つか}い{方|かた}, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教|おし}え{方|かた}が{上手|じょうず}: good at teaching
- {教|おし}え{方|かた}が{下手|へた}: bad at teaching
- {教|おし}え{方|かた}を{工夫|くふう}する: to put thought into one's teaching method
- {教|おし}え{方|かた}を{学|まな}ぶ: to learn how to teach

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指導法|しどうほう}: instructional method — more formal/technical, often used in education research
- {授業|じゅぎょう}スタイル: teaching style — focused on classroom delivery rather than method
